headline.text: S1 and S3 enrobers both found metal and nuts during startup, required *re-clean* and ATP verification before release.

summary: Two Lindon 1 enrobers flagged foreign material (metal, nuts, metallic powder) at startup and were re-cleaned. One S2 caramel batch was rejected as dark/bitter and held for disposition. ML1 allergen test for toffee-bit screen still pending at window close.

holds.title: Excess salt in S4 product
holds.summary: Operator detected excess salt in caramel at 10:30 on 11/09; all affected product removed from line and production restarted at 11:25.
holds.status: Resolved on shift — product removed and line restarted.

holds.title: S2 reserve-tank caramel dark and bitter
holds.summary: Caramel held in reserve tank since 8:10 PM evaluated by QA at 11:39 PM as dark and bitter; QA advised to discard.
holds.status: On hold pending disposition — QA rejected for quality.

food_safety.title: Metal and nuts in S1 NEW enrober
food_safety.summary: Startup inspection at 09:51 found metal, nuts, and blue plastic shavings in enrober; line stopped, enrober re-cleaned, QA visual and ATP passed before release.
food_safety.status: Resolved — enrober re-cleaned, ATP passed, released to production.

food_safety.title: Metal and nuts in S3 enrober
food_safety.summary: Mary found metallic powder mixed with oil in screw and nuts in wire mesh at startup; production requested re-clean before release.
food_safety.status: Resolved — enrober re-cleaned and released after second verification.

food_safety.title: Nuts in S3 enrober drain
food_safety.summary: Charity found nuts in drain adjacent to enrober during re-clean inspection; flagged to maintenance and FSQA.
food_safety.status: Open — drain contamination documented, awaiting cleaning confirmation.

food_safety.title: Pretzels found on S1 NEW bed
food_safety.summary: Italu found pretzels on bed during Hershey graham-cookie trial; potential allergen cross-contact from prior run.
food_safety.status: Resolved — pretzels removed; bed inspected before trial restart.

food_safety.title: Blue plastic shavings on S1 NEW belt C19
food_safety.summary: Constanza noticed blue plastic shavings on belt C19 during cleaning inspection; Z conveyor run for 2 minutes showed no additional shavings.
food_safety.status: Resolved — shavings removed; belt monitored during startup with no recurrence.

quality.title: S2 metal detector test missed at 06:30
quality.summary: Chris unable to perform final metal detector verification at 06:30 due to S3 mechanical issues and maintenance unavailability.
quality.status: Open — test deferred; no alternate time confirmed on record.

quality.title: Truffle tunnel temps out of centerline
quality.summary: Grey reported tunnel temps out of CL; yesterday's adjustment made product too soft, so he elected not to bring back to CL today to finish order.
quality.status: Open — deviation documented; Shawn acknowledged and will adjust CL range for this flavor.

quality.title: ML4 TG position-sensor targets retrained without escalation
quality.summary: Shawn found TG position-indicator sensors retrained across all three machines; values that ran perfectly last week now fault — changes made without communication.
quality.status: Open — Shawn escalated to Ray and updated centerline sheets; root cause of retraining unknown.

quality.title: ML4 lot number not printing on TG4
quality.summary: WDS operator called maintenance at 00:33; lot number missing because film roll not pushed all the way back — training issue flagged.
quality.status: Resolved — maintenance fixed; operator coached on roll installation.

sanitation.title: S1 NEW Level 4 clean not signed off
sanitation.summary: Charity flagged that several Level 4 clean areas have not been documented or signed off as completed in the book.
sanitation.status: Open — areas awaiting sign-off before next production run.

allergen.title: ML1 toffee-bit screen allergen test pending
allergen.summary: Grey requested allergen test for almond-bit screen being used for ZS Heath toffee trial; Jenny reported at 13:24 still waiting for results.
allergen.status: Open, awaiting QA allergen verification before screen use.

opportunities.text: Consider adding final foreign-material inspection step to S1 and S3 enrober startup checklists — today both found metal/nuts/powder at first startup requiring re-clean.
Review Level 4 clean sign-off process on S1 NEW — Charity found multiple areas completed but not documented in logbook.
Consider formalizing ML4 centerline change-approval workflow — Shawn found TG sensor targets retrained across all three machines without escalation or documentation.
